verdict.rationale: Digits documents real-time connections to 12,000+ financial institutions, with named connectors for Stripe (payments), Gusto (payroll), and Ramp. It also documents auto-booking of 95%+ of transactions in real time, so connected activity flows into the ledger without manual work. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connector reliability, in-depth documentation of connection setup and sync behavior per connector type.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: Digits Connect API seamlessly integrates with 12,000+ financial institutions, giving you real-time visibility into the metrics that matter—without delays or manual work
auto-booking 95%+ of transactions in real time, delivering always up-to-date financials
collects financial activity continuously, books transactions inside the ledger
